cookbooks.title: Cookbooks
cookbooks.subtitle: Let's cook!
cookbooks.intro.title: What's a cookbook?
cookbooks.intro.body: A cookbook is a reusable way to turn a meeting into a specific kind of note or report: a sales debrief, a 1:1 record, a standup digest. Pick one when you generate notes, or make it your default.
cookbooks.featured.blurb: Hand-picked by Steno to get you started.
cookbooks.categoryBlurb.briefings: Distil what was said into what was decided.
cookbooks.categoryBlurb.interviews: Conversations with customers, candidates and clients.
cookbooks.categoryBlurb.planning: Look back, look ahead, and keep track of who owns what.
cookbooks.categoryBlurb.everyday: Quick syncs and the meetings that fill the week.
cookbooks.empty.searchHint: Try a different word, or clear the category filter.
cookbooks.empty.mine: You haven't written a cookbook yet.
cookbooks.empty.mineHint: Start from a blank page and describe the note you want Steno to produce.
cookbooks.newTileHint: Write your own recipe for a note.
cookbooks.desc.standard: Steno's classic structured note: a summary, discussion areas, key points and action items.
cookbooks.desc.salesCall: Needs, objections, budget and timeline, and the next steps agreed on a sales call.
cookbooks.desc.oneOnOne: Updates, feedback in both directions, blockers, and follow-ups with owners.
cookbooks.desc.productDemo: What was shown, how well it fits, pricing, open concerns and next steps.
cookbooks.desc.standup: A brief digest of done, next and blocked, grouped by person or topic.
cookbooks.desc.shareableSummary: A plain-language recap of key points and decisions, ready to forward.
chat.presets.owePeople.label: What do I owe people
chat.presets.owePeople.prompt: List everything I committed to do for other people in my recent meetings, grouped by person, with the meeting each commitment came from.
chat.presets.owePeople.description: Your open commitments, grouped by person

chat.presets.followUp.label: Draft the follow-up
chat.presets.followUp.prompt: Draft a short follow-up email for my most recent meeting: thank the attendees, recap the decisions and list the action items with owners.
chat.presets.followUp.description: A recap email, ready to send
chat.presets.decisionLog.label: Decision log
chat.presets.decisionLog.prompt: List the decisions made across my recent meetings, with the date, the meeting and who made each one.
chat.presets.decisionLog.description: Every decision, with when and who
chat.presets.prd.label: Write a PRD
chat.presets.prd.prompt: Write a product requirements document from my recent meetings: the problem, goals, users, requirements and open questions.
chat.presets.prd.description: Turns discussions into a requirements doc
